name: Groxy AI Curated SEO, Accessibility & Clean-DOM Playbook

grade_scale.summary: Exceptional — ready to publish with top search, accessibility, and clean-DOM signals
Strong — passes all critical standards with only minor polish ideas
Good — solid foundation; quick Groxy improvements will raise search & UX quality
Fair — noticeable SEO, heading, alt-text, or contrast gaps to address
Needs Work — significant structural, SEO, or accessibility defects
Failing / Unsafe — critical SEO, WCAG AA, wrapper-<div>, or security issues present

rules.title: Optimal SEO Title Length
rules.description: Title tag or entry.title exists and spans 30-65 characters (50-60 characters optimal to avoid SERP truncation).

rules.title: Focus Keyword Alignment & Natural Density
rules.description: Target focus keyword (or inferred topic term) appears naturally in title and primary H1/opening copy with <= 3% density.

rules.title: Meta Description / Excerpt Length
rules.description: Meta description or entry.excerpt is present and 120-158 characters (<= 160 max to avoid search snippet clipping).

rules.title: Clean Lowercase Hyphenated URL Slug
rules.description: Slug matches ^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$, stays <= 75 chars, avoids stop-word bloat, and never collides with reserved route prefixes.

rules.title: Single Primary H1 Heading
rules.description: Exactly one <h1> (Heading level 1) exists in the primary content flow matching page search intent.

rules.title: Content Depth & Subheading Scannability
rules.description: Substantive editorial copy (>= 300 words for post/article or >= 120 words for page/product) structured with H2/H3 subheadings.

rules.title: Site-Wide Title & Slug Uniqueness
rules.description: Zero duplicate title or colliding slug across site entries returned by query_entries.

rules.title: Exact GrabDecimal / GrabInteger Numeric Integrity
rules.description: Structured numeric custom fields preserve exact base-10 wire strings with zero IEEE-754 float coercion or NaN drift.

rules.title: WCAG AA Color Contrast Ratio
rules.description: Text/background color pairs across nodes and --grex-* tokens meet >= 4.5:1 (>= 3.0:1 for large text).

rules.title: Descriptive Image Alt Text
rules.description: Every Image supplies descriptive alt text (3-125 chars, not a raw filename) or explicit decorative: true / isDecorative: true.

rules.title: Accessible Form Input & Select Labels
rules.description: Every Input and Select exposes a non-empty label, aria-label, or aria-labelledby.

rules.title: Sequential Semantic Heading Hierarchy
rules.description: Heading levels (h1 -> h2 -> h3...) advance sequentially with zero skipped heading levels.

rules.title: Accessible Interactive Controls & Focus Rings
rules.description: Every Button and Link provides a non-empty accessible label and preserves visible :focus-visible outlines.

rules.title: Zero Wrapper-<div> Guarantee
rules.description: Layout tree and rendered HTML contain zero <div> wrapper tags (any <div> forces overall grade F and publish_safe: false).

rules.title: Strict 20-Element Grex Semantic Allowlist
rules.description: All nodes belong strictly to the 20 Grex elements with allowed semantic HTML5 tags (section, main, header, nav, article, aside, footer).

rules.title: Zero XSS, Inline Script & Unsafe URL Guard
rules.description: Zero <script>, <iframe>, <object>, <style>, on* handlers, innerHTML/srcdoc, unsafe protocols, or CSS expression() (violation caps Clean DOM at 0 and grade at F).

rules.title: DOM Depth & Lean Node Budget
rules.description: Layout nesting stays <= 24 levels (<= 10 optimal) and total node count stays <= 150 nodes.

rules.title: GRAB-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md Token & Class Fidelity
rules.description: Reuses registered --grex-* tokens and .grex-c-* utility classes instead of unknown classes or excessive inline style overrides.

rules.title: Internal Link Presence & Descriptive Anchors
rules.description: Includes descriptive internal links (1-2 per 500 words) without vague anchors such as click here or read more.

rules.title: Broken Link, Loop & 301 Slug History Guard
rules.description: Detects self-loops, broken internal targets, and links pointing to superseded 301 redirect slugs instead of canonical URLs.

rules.title: Navigation & Orphan Page Discoverability
rules.description: Checks whether the entry is reachable from site navigation menus or sibling internal links.

rules.title: Schema.org Rich Result Metadata Readiness
rules.description: Verifies required metadata for structured data output (author/date/excerpt for posts, exact GrabDecimal price/SKU for products, headings for pages).
